simple.meaning: Elon , the name of a place in Palestine, and also of one Hittite, two Israelites

definitions.short: Elon , the name of a place in Palestine, and also of one Hittite, two Israelites
definitions.full: H356. Elon II. אֵלוֺן proper name, masculine (= id. compare אֵלָה proper name ) 1 a son of Zebulun Gen 46:14 ; Num 26:26 . 2 אֵילֹן Gen 26:34 ; אֵיִלוֺן 36:2 a Hittite, father-in-law of Esau. 3 אֵילוֺן Judg 12:11-12 , a judge of Israel, of tribe of Zebulun 4. proper name, of a location אֵילוֺן Josh 19:43 a town of Dan; so 1Kin 4:9 (where read ׳א ח ׳וּבֵית Th Klo).
definitions.rootNote: or (shortened) אֵלוֹן ; or אֵילֹן ; from 352 ; oak-grove;
